description.value: Yaga Cafe Garden Co. is a community-owned cafe and garden centre in Seal Cove, Prince Rupert, operated by the Gitmaxmak'ay Nisga'a Society — a Nisga'a Indigenous non-profit — since 2013 and winner of the 2021 BC Indigenous Community-Owned Business of the Year. The cafe serves coffee, tea, sandwiches, snacks, and fresh salads harvested from onsite hydroponics greenhouses on the same scenic property. The business has operated at this site since 1991 and features a scenic outdoor patio overlooking Seal Cove.

address.value: 2250 Bellis Road, Prince Rupert, British Columbia V8J 2P2, Canada
